title: Caerlum Rising Revisited
premise: Wendell Nakamura, a half-blood cartographer who has spent her life mapping the unmapped and keeping her guild's ledgers of impossible trades, discovers the border wards fell the same night the stars went out because someone inside the guild sold the sky. As an endless winter descends, she traces the theft to the crown itself: a parasitic thing of old starlight wearing King Aldric like a glove. Torn between duty to the guild that sheltered her and love for Aldric, the man still flickering beneath the crown, Wendell must unbind the king by rewriting the one map she was forbidden to draw—the true borders of her own identity. She succeeds at terrible cost, trading her place in the guild's ledgers to restore the stars, and the book ends with a free king, a thawing border, and Wendell finally mapped, known, and home.
about_author: Mara Nakamura is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing maps of places that no longer exist. She writes fantasy about people who survive by staying unreadable.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Wendell, working late in the guild's map-vault, watches the stars extinguish one by one and feels the border wards snap like cut threads. POV: Wendell. Emotional beat: dread and a strange, guilty relief—her invisibility has finally failed her.

chapters.title: Ledgers of Impossible Things
chapters.summary: Wendell audits the guild's ledgers and finds a transaction dated the night of the fall: a trade of 'sky, whole.' Her mentor, Master Corvel, warns her to stop looking. POV: Wendell. Emotional beat: the first crack in her faith in the guild that raised her.

chapters.title: A King Wearing Winter
chapters.summary: Summoned to court to map the failing wards, Wendell meets King Aldric and recognizes the crown's true nature—a thing of cold starlight feeding on him. She glimpses the man beneath, and he recognizes her from a dream he never had. POV: Wendell. Emotional beat: love at first sight shadowed by horror.

chapters.title: The Cartographer's Oath
chapters.summary: Flashback chapter: young Wendell's induction into the guild, her oath never to map herself, and the half-blood status that made her the perfect invisible keeper of secrets. POV: Wendell. Emotional beat: understanding why she chose erasure—and what it cost.

chapters.title: What the Frost Remembers
chapters.summary: Wendell and Aldric flee the capital as the crown's agents hunt them, sheltering in a village frozen mid-moment since the fall. The ice preserves memories, and Wendell reads one that names the guild. POV: Aldric, his first chapter. Emotional beat: fragile trust kindling into intimacy.

chapters.title: The Trade of Sky
chapters.summary: Following the ledger trail, they find the broker who sold the sky: Corvel, who traded the stars to the crown-thing to buy the guild another century of neutrality. POV: Wendell. Emotional beat: betrayal sharpened by pity—Corvel believed he was saving her.

chapters.title: Borders of the Self
chapters.summary: In the guild's deepest vault, Wendell finds the forbidden map of her own bloodline: she is descended from the ward-smiths who forged the crown's prison. The thing wearing the crown has been hunting its jailer's heir. POV: Wendell. Emotional beat: terror transmuting into purpose—her identity is the weapon.

chapters.title: The Long Winter Finishes Falling
chapters.summary: The crown-thing, aware of her now, offers a trade: Aldric's life for her surrender as its new vessel. Wendell pretends to accept while secretly drafting the unbinding map with Aldric's fading help. POV: Aldric. Emotional beat: love against duty—he tries to refuse salvation to spare her.

chapters.title: Unbinding the King
chapters.summary: At the ruined border shrine, Wendell draws the unbinding in her own blood, mapping herself for the first time as the crown-thing takes her. Aldric, freed, chooses to stay inside the collapsing ward and anchor her with his name and his love. Climax. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: sacrifice met with refusal to let go.

chapters.title: Caerlum Rising
chapters.summary: The stars reignite; the crown-thing is imprisoned in a map that Wendell seals with both their names. The guild's ledgers burn, Corvel faces judgment, and Wendell—no longer invisible—begins a new atlas of the thawed realm with Aldric beside her. POV: Wendell. Emotional beat: hard-won peace; identity chosen, not hidden.
